paragraphs: Rav Pinchas son of Rav Mari.
Mentioned in [Zevachim 4b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.4b.3). Dikdukei Soferim reads “son of Rav Ami,” which Hyman considers correct.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls him Rav Pinchas son of Rav Mari, the name under which [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2966&lang=en) also lists him. Hyman reports “son of Rav Ami” from Dikdukei Soferim and judges it correct. The apparatus reading remains uncollated here.
